<entry id="N00728">
<head-word>נִיפּוּל</head-word>

<pos> m.</pos>

<sense>
<definition> (נָפַל) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>falling off</italic>, esp. (with ref. to Lev. XI, 3</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>of a limb detached from the body</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 74
<sup>a</sup> מיתה עושה נ' וכ' the natural death of an animal causes the hanging limb (דִּלְדּוּל) to be considered as if detached (in life-time, so that it does not come under the law of נְבֵלָה), but slaughtering does not &c. (and the dangling limb is considered as a part of the slaughtered animal. Ib. 129
<sup>a</sup> אי מיתה עושה נ' ליטמא וכ' if death causes the limb to be considered as detached, let it be susceptible of uncleanness as a limb cut off from a live animal, and if not &c.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. נִיפּוּלִין</plural-form>. פת נ' 
<italic>bread which falls apart, spoiled bread</italic>. Tosef. B. Kam X, 9; B. Kam. 99
<sup>b</sup>; B. Bath. 93
<sup>b</sup>. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VI פת ניפולה (corr. acc.; Yalk. Lev. 675 נוֹפֶלֶת).—[V. נִיפּוֹלִין.]—2) 
<italic>falling down</italic> for prayer. Deut. R. s. 2, beg. (as one of the expressions for prayer, with ref. to Deut. IX, 25); Yalk. ib. 811; Sifré ib. 26.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="N00751">
<head-word>נִיצוֹץ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (נָצַץ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>spark, sparkling light</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayesheb 1 נ' אחד וכ' one spark from thy smithy.—
<plural-form>Pl. נִיצוֹצוֹת, נִיצוֹצִים, נִיצוֹצִין</plural-form>. Tosef. Yoma II, 3 היו נ' יוצאות ממנה sparkling rays proceeded from it (the golden tablet); Yoma 37
<sup>b</sup> נ' יוצאין; Y. ib. III, 41
<sup>a</sup> top הנ' מנתזין; Y. Sot. II, 18
<sup>a</sup> top הניצוצים וכ'. Num. R. s. 5, beg. שני נ' של אש וכ' two sparks of fire &c. Ib. שני נצ' מקדמין וכ' two sparks preceded them. Y. Ab. Zar. V, end, 45
<sup>b</sup> (v. לִיבּוּן) צריך שיהא נ' וכ' it must be so heated that sparks burst forth from it. Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 2 נפלו הימנו נ' ואמר וכ' if snuff falls off the candle, and he says, we shall have guests &c. (v. אֱמֹורִי). Sabb. III, 6 לקבל נ' to receive the snuff; a. fr.—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>shivers scattering from the broken sledge-hammer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 88
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 34
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Jer. XXIII, 29) מה פטיש זה מתחלק לכמה נ' as the sledge-hammer (when shattered by 
<pgbrk id="pg908" />the harder rock) is divided into many shivers (differ. in commentaries).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>squirtings</italic> (of boiling water &c.).</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 76
<sup>b</sup> מה בולעו נ' וכ' as the rim of a caldron absorbs forbidden substances through squirtings, so does it emit them again through the squirtings (of the boiling cleansing water, v. גִּיעוּל). Nidd. 13
<sup>a</sup> נ' נתזין וכ' drippings (of urine) squirt upon his feet. Yoma 29
<sup>b</sup>, sq.; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (cmp. Arab. 
<italic>nu</italic>
<italic>ḍ</italic>
<italic>â</italic>
<italic>ḍ</italic>
<italic>ah</italic>) 
<italic>residue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 139
<sup>b</sup> האיכא נ' but there is the residue (the last drops percolating through the dregs in emptying liquid from vessel to vessel); נ' לבי ר' וכ' that residue was not cared about in the house of &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>

<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִכִּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recognize, know; to favor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ruth R. to II, 10 (ref. to להכירני, ib.) נתנבאה … להַכִּירָהּ כדרך וכ' she prophesied that he would know her in the way of all people (as his wife, cmp. יָדַע). Ber. 10
<sup>b</sup> האשה מַכֶּרֶת באורחין וכ' woman recognizes the character of guests better than man. R. Hash. II, 1 אם אינן מַכִּירִין אותו if the court does not know him personally. Y. Yeb. IV, 6
<sup>b</sup> כנסה ולא הִכִּירָהּ he married her but did not touch her (v. supra). Snh. 7
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. I, 17) לא תַכִּירֵהוּ thou shalt not 
<pgbrk id="pg912" />favor him (if he is thy friend); a. fr.—Num. R. s. 9 במקום שמכיר where he knows (the people), where he is acquainted; Sifré Num. 14 במקום שמכירין אותו.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make known, identify; to acknowledge, own</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. l. c. מן המכירים on the declaration of those who identify (the witnesses; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2). Gen. R. s. 43 לא היה שמי ניכר … והִכַּרְתָּ אותי וכ' my name was unknown … and thou hast made me known among my creatures. Sifré Deut. 217; Kidd. 78
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. (ref. to יכיר, Deut. XXI, 17) יַכִּירֶנּוּ לאחרים he may identify him before others (as his first born son). Sifré Deut. 312 שאהיה מַכִּירוֹ that I may make it known as mine. Ib. מהיכן המקום מַכִּיר את חלקו beginning with whom does the Lord acknowledge his share (claim as his)? With Jacob; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּכָּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be recognized; to be discernible</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. III, 5 ה' עוברה her pregnancy was certain, v. הַכָּרָה; ib. 62
<sup>b</sup>. B. Mets. 93
<sup>b</sup> ה' הגנב the thief was found out; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִיכַּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Part. נִיכָּר. Ber. 28
<sup>a</sup> מכותלי … אתה נ' וכ' by the walls of thy house, one sees that thou art a smith. Kidd. 31
<sup>a</sup> מסוף דברך נ' וכ' from thy last words (the fifth and following commandments of the decalogue) it is seen that thy first one is true. Ib. מבין ריסי עיניך נ', v. 
<xref rid="unknown">רִיס</xref>. Gitt. 53
<sup>a</sup> שאינו נ', v. הֶיזֵּק. Sabb. 91
<sup>b</sup> מקומו נ' its location is discernible. Sot. 9
<sup>b</sup> נִיכָּרִין דברי אמת words of truth are easily recognized. Gen. R. s. 43, v. supra; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִכֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to treat as a stranger, ignore; to discriminate against</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. l. c. (ref. to Deut. I, 17) לא תְנַכְּרֵהוּ (if he is thy enemy) do not discriminate against him (v. supra). Sifré Deut. 322 בשעת … מְנַכְּרִים וכ' when Israel is in trouble, the nations ignore them and act as though they did not know them; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
